industry_benchmark.notes: 只读参照线，不参与告警/阻断。厂商宣传和媒体测评口径不一，落地前应由 n2d-review 流程自审重新复核。2026 现实：常规 AI 漫剧全链成本已降到每分钟 400-1000 元（旧 1500-2500）；纯付费漫剧市场 ROI 中位约 1.1，仅前 5% 头部稳住 1.2+；爆款新鲜期缩至约 3 周——成本纪律与上新速度同为生死线。Seedance 2.0 可用率从 20% 跃升至 ~90%，盲目抽卡应随之收敛（见 n2d-video 出视频规格『QC 门控重抽』）。

creative_attention.caption_words_per_sec.definition: Readable caption or on-screen text density band for short-form vertical creative.

creative_attention.first_3s_proposition_.definition: First 3 seconds should make the content proposition readable before deeper body content.

creative_attention.first_6s_hook_require.definition: The first 6 seconds carry most ad recall impact and must contain a hook.

episode_kpi_targets.first_episode_comple.definition: First-episode completion-rate QC floor (≥0.75): below this signals a content or player problem. Ep1 is the make-or-break episode, audited separately from the generic completion_rate target.

episode_kpi_targets.required_metrics.definition: Episode and series KPIs required for a usable short-form series feedback loop.

proxy_thresholds.cold_open_pull_floor.definition: Per-episode cold-open pull-strength floor (0-1, 4-layer conflict/suspense/reversal/info weighting). Below floor = opening has a hook but lacks depth. Motivated by Sensor Tower's opening-hook-vs-cliffhanger unlock correlation; the 0.3 cut is an internal heuristic, advisory-only, recalibrate via n2d-feedback.

proxy_thresholds.combat_cut_interval_slo.definition: Internal heuristic upper bound for mean shot/cut interval inside a combat (fight_exchange/magic_burst) clip; above = sluggish action cadence. Grounded in the general short-drama '画面每~5s 一切' editing tip + 导演节奏.md action curve (combat should cut AT LEAST that dense). NOT an external published combat cuts-per-second figure — 2026-06-28 search found none. advisory-only.

proxy_thresholds.density_fast_per_min.definition: Internal heuristic upper bound for shots-per-minute (above = fatigue). NOT an external CPM benchmark — see density_slow_per_min note; advisory-only, recalibrate via n2d-feedback first-party metrics.

proxy_thresholds.density_slow_per_min.definition: Internal heuristic lower bound for shots-per-minute (below = PPT-slow). NOT an external CPM benchmark — 2026-06-25 search found no defensible published cuts/shots-per-minute figure for short drama; derived from 导演节奏.md shot-duration curve. advisory-only.

proxy_thresholds.hook_gap_sec.definition: Domestic mid-episode max gap (sec) between hooks before audience drift risk (导演节奏 §二 每 15-20s 一钩). Internal heuristic, advisory-only; beat_audit uses it as the default region's hook-gap ceiling, recalibrate via n2d-feedback.

proxy_thresholds.hook_window_sec.definition: Local proxy window for evaluating whether the opening contains a cold visual hook.

proxy_thresholds.overseas_combat_cut_int.definition: Overseas (ReelShort/TikTok) combat cadence is tighter than domestic; internal heuristic lower-than-domestic upper bound for mean combat cut interval. Same internal-heuristic basis as combat_cut_interval_slow_sec. advisory-only.

proxy_thresholds.overseas_hook_gap_sec.definition: Overseas (ReelShort/TikTok) tightened max gap (sec) between hooks/reversals; ~10s vs domestic ~20s. Applied by beat_audit only when 变现模式=海外 or 发行地区 is overseas (北美/东南亚/全球). Practitioner-grade, advisory-only.

proxy_thresholds.retention_hook_floor.definition: Internal pre-release proxy target for strong opening retention; must be recalibrated by first-party metrics.

adjoe_sensor_tower_cold_open_unlock_2026.definition: Public summary observing next-episode unlock rate correlates with the current episode's opening-hook strength more than with the prior episode-end cliffhanger. Motivates a per-episode cold-open pull-strength floor; advisory-only proxy, recalibrate via first-party metrics.

n2d_internal_pacing_heuristic_2026.definition: Internal pacing proxy derived from 导演节奏.md shot-duration curve (铺垫 3-5s/镜、爽点碎切 1-2s/镜). 2026-06-25 流程自审实搜确认：短剧『镜/分钟』『每N秒一钩』无可辩护的公开 CPM/SPM 基准，故此口径明确标为内部启发式、非市场基准，只作 advisory 旁路评估，正式阈值须由 n2d-feedback 第一方数据校准。校准已落地（2026-06-27）：`n2d-feedback --write-pacing-profiles` 据第一方留存/跳出写 生产数据/pacing_profiles.json（kind n2d_pacing_profiles），pacing_retention.py 在 evidence_status=calibrated 时优先采用其 density_slow/fast_per_min，覆盖此处默认值。

Practitioner/white-paper grade, not a platform-official metric; advisory-only, recalibrate via n2d-feedback first-party data.
